criteria.description: Patient is 18 years of age or older.
criteria.source_quote: The patient is 18 years of age or older.
criteria.source_location: Coverage Criteria > Reduction in Excess Body Weight, Maintenance of Weight Reduction Long Term (Adult)
criteria.interpretation_notes: Age computed from Patient.birthDate on the request date.

criteria.description: Requested to reduce excess body weight / maintain weight reduction long term (chronic weight management).
criteria.source_quote: Authorization may be granted when the requested drug will be used with a reduced-calorie diet AND increased physical activity to reduce excess body weight or maintain weight reduction long term when ALL of the following criteria are met:

criteria.description: Drug will be used with a reduced-calorie diet AND increased physical activity (going forward).
criteria.source_quote: the requested drug will be used with a reduced-calorie diet AND increased physical activity
criteria.interpretation_notes: Judged from the most recent documentation around the request: is the patient currently following (or planned to continue) BOTH a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity alongside the drug? Explicit 'not currently following a diet or exercise plan' fails; silence is insufficient. USER-APPROVED (2026-09-29): must be documented — no lifestyle documentation near the request is INSUFFICIENT; explicit non-adherence is FAIL; requires BOTH diet and activity. Operationalization (2026-09-29): 'near the request' = documentation dated within 180 days before the request date; older lifestyle documentation alone is INSUFFICIENT.

criteria.description: Participated in a comprehensive weight management program (behavioral modification + reduced-calorie diet + increased physical activity, with continuing follow-up) for at least 6 months prior to drug therapy.
criteria.source_quote: The patient has participated in a comprehensive weight management program that encourages behavioral modification, reduced-calorie diet, AND increased physical activity with continuing follow-up for at least 6 months prior to using drug therapy.
criteria.interpretation_notes: Hybrid design: models identify program START / CONTINUATION / STOP events and their dates; code computes duration with calendar whole months (2026-02-18 -> 2026-08-18 = 6). Interruptions (stop, lapse) break continuity. Undated or vague durations ('several months', 'for years') cannot establish >= 6 months. Behavioral modification component is taken as satisfied by a structured program with follow-up (not separately required in text — see open question).

criteria.description: Baseline BMI >= 30, OR baseline BMI >= 27 AND at least one weight-related comorbid condition (documented).
criteria.source_quote: The patient has a baseline body mass index (BMI) greater than or equal to 30 kg/m2. ... [ACTION REQUIRED: Documentation is required for approval.] / The patient has a baseline BMI greater than or equal to 27 kg/m2. ... In addition, the following criteria is met: ... The patient has at least ONE weight-related comorbid condition (e.g., hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, dyslipidemia). ... [ACTION REQUIRED: Documentation is required for approval.]
criteria.interpretation_notes: 'Baseline' = BMI at the start of drug therapy = latest recorded structured BMI before the request (no patient is transitioning from another weight-loss drug at request time). Same comorbidity logic as other policies. USER-APPROVED (2026-09-29): latest recorded structured BMI governs; elevated BP without diagnosis is CONFLICT.
